docs.title: A little guidance. A clearer start.
docs.description: Learn how to enter the preview, find your workspace and build a dashboard around your day.
docs.sectionDescription: These guides describe the current product preview, not a live production service.

cards.title: 1. Enter your workspace
cards.description: Open Login and use one of the five demo accounts documented in the repository’s ROLE_MODEL.md. Your role determines the starting console and available modules.

cards.title: 2. Customize your dashboard
cards.description: Choose Customize on a supported dashboard. Add widgets from the library, drag their handles or use the move buttons, then adjust titles, width and detail density.

cards.title: 3. Save your layout
cards.description: Save commits your changes to this browser for your account and console. Cancel discards the current edit. Undo and redo let you explore safely.

cards.title: 4. Understand the preview
cards.description: Dashboard layouts persist locally; operational records do not. Reloading requires signing in again. Only synthetic data should be used.

cards.title: 5. Work with the keyboard
cards.description: Tab to a drag handle. Press Space to pick up, arrow keys to move and Space to drop. Escape cancels a drag. Move earlier/later buttons provide another option.

cards.title: 6. Move a layout
cards.description: Export downloads presentation settings only. Import validates the file and removes widgets your role cannot use. Saving applies the imported draft.

docs.closingDescription: Your workspace is one sign-in away.
